story.title: Made for the people who play.
story.builtBy: Built by a tennis player, for tennis players.
story.body1: PlayTennis.lt is independent. We don't organise the tournaments. We don't sell memberships. We don't promote one club over another.
story.body2: We collect adult amateur and Masters tennis tournaments from the Baltics and beyond, then point you to the official source so you can enter.

sourcesModal.title: A little clarity about the data.
sourcesModal.intro: PlayTennis.lt is a calendar, not an organiser. Listings come from public directories, organiser pages, Facebook event links pasted by admins, and the ITF Masters calendar.
sourcesModal.directoriesBody: Public directory links for finding amateur tournaments in Lithuania. Listings link out to the original source.
sourcesModal.facebookBody: Facebook does not offer a public group-event feed for apps like ours. Admins paste public event URLs, then we check and publish them.
sourcesModal.itfBody: Masters events are taken from the ITF World Tennis Masters Tour calendar. Always confirm details on the official ITF page before registering.
sourcesModal.missingBody: We show Unconfirmed, Not provided or Link unavailable. Unknown fees are never treated as free, and past events never accept registrations here.
sourcesModal.privateBody: Saved tournaments and language preference stay in this browser. Registration always happens on the organiser's site.
